title: Service overview
description: RED metrics (rate, errors, duration) and database pool for one service, from OpenTelemetry metrics. Pick the service with the variable at the top.

panels.title: 4xx rate
panels.description: Share of responses with status 4xx (includes expected ones such as 404 profile_not_found).

panels.title: 4xx / s by route and status
panels.description: 401/403 from Envoy (missing or invalid token) never reach the service and are not counted here.

panels.title: 5xx error rate by route
panels.description: Share of each route's responses that are 5xx. Routes with traffic and no errors show 0.

targets.expr: (sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$service", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per latency bucket over time; shows outliers that percentiles hide.

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CFS periods in which the container hit its CPU limit.

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$service-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$service-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory per pod (working set)
panels.description: The kubelet OOM-kills the container when the working set reaches the limit.

panels.title: Goroutine scheduling latency
panels.description: Time goroutines wait to run. Rising values mean the process is CPU-starved (throttling or too few cores).

panels.title: Pool waits
panels.description: Non-zero waits mean the pool is exhausted: requests queue for a connection.
